system.description:
Range 120ft; one creature, object or 20ft-radius area.

  • Each ongoing spell effect there ends automatically if the spell's level is 3 or lower; for a higher level, make a casting check (d20 + casting-stat modifier + half your level (minimum 1)) vs DC 10 + the spell's level.
  • A magic item in the area is suppressed for 1d4 rounds if you succeed on a casting check against DC 10 + its rarity (Uncommon 1, Rare 3, Very Rare 5); a worn or carried item uses its bearer's Will save instead.
  • Artefacts and Uniques are unaffected.

Classes: Wizard, Illusionist, Cleric, Warlock, Bard, Paladin, Magus, Witch
system.saveEffect: A worn or carried magic item is not suppressed
